thread:
Maya: Heads-up before handoff — planning a small alert routing/squelch for the EU maintenance tonight at 20:00 UTC. Goal: silence transient batch latency spikes but keep real failures paged.

Maya: Short checklist: add temporary squelch to high-p95 alert; route noisy spikes to #eng-oncall-ops; lower cpu-threshold severity to warning for 30m; dry-run then apply; set auto-expire at 21:10 UTC.

Liam: @Maya paste the rule you'll push? I can run the dry-run and watch logs. :eyes:

Maya: rule snippet below (only changes shown):
```yaml
- alert: HighP95Latency
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[2m])) by (le, service)) > 1.0
  for: 1m
  labels:
    severity: critical
    route: eng-oncall-ops
    squelch: 5m
  annotations:
    summary: "P95 request latency > 1s (temp squelch for EU maintenance)"
```

Sophia: I can watch dashboards 20:05-20:35. If anything looks off I will revert and page. :thumbsup:

Liam: running dry-run now: `infractl alert apply --file tmp/eu-squelch.yaml --dry-run`

Liam: dry-run output: "validated 1/1 rules; no collisions" — syntax looks good.

OncallBot: NOTICE: EU maintenance window 19:50-21:10 UTC. Autoscaling load tests scheduled 20:00-20:30 UTC.

Maya: safety clause: if any service reports error_rate > 10/min in last 5m, we immediately unmute and route back to #pager. Quick check command: `promql 'sum(rate(errors_total[5m])) by (service) > 10'`.

Sophia: agree. If threshold hits I'll run `infractl alert revert --id <change-id>` and ping #pager.

DevExBot: Reminder: add audit comment on apply. Suggested: "temp squelch for EU maintenance — Maya". I will auto-append.

Maya: adding metadata: expires_at=2026-03-17T21:10:00Z and audit comment. I'll schedule apply at 20:05 UTC after dry-run at 20:00.

Liam: also recommend adding a follow-up reminder for 21:05 UTC to confirm the rule auto-expired. I can /remind for that.

Maya: good idea — please set the reminder. Applying in ~2m. Sophia on watch, Liam validating.

OncallBot: ACTION: routing-change requested by Maya scheduled at 1765432200.

Maya: applied change-id `chg_17654321_01` at 1765432205. Audit: "temp squelch for EU maintenance — Maya". Rule has expires_at set.

Liam: verified: `infractl alert status --id chg_17654321_01` -> "applied". Prometheus shows p95 alerts still firing but routed to #eng-oncall-ops, no pages triggered.

Sophia: monitoring dashboards. so far steady. Will revert and page if error_rate > 10/min.

Maya: handing off remaining watch to @Liam after a quick meeting. Handoff note: "watch routing until 21:10 UTC; revert if errors spike; change-id chg_17654321_01". :memo:

Liam: ack. Thanks for the tidy process. Good handoff.
